windows.notes: Fixed: sending a message or file while offline (or a connection dropping mid-transfer) used to silently look successful. Fixed: burn-on-close (deleting a chat for both people when one of you closes the app) is now much more reliable, and now also deletes any files that were part of that conversation.

macos.notes: Fixed: sending a message or file while offline (or a connection dropping mid-transfer) used to silently look successful. Fixed: burn-on-close (deleting a chat for both people when one of you closes the app) is now much more reliable, and now also deletes any files that were part of that conversation. Unsigned build — right-click the app and choose Open the first time to get past Gatekeeper.
